summary: Round 2 of LEGION-25 Part B (legion controller start, the operator-launched controller for runtime: kubernetes) on pull request #1110, reviewed at code head 40fbcb269e805acbe92b1201004098a48a313a85 (code last changed in fe40d7fa; branch head a0b1dc7c adds only the implement handoff) after the conflict-forced rebase onto main 73a526e3. Verdict REQUEST_CHANGES: one correctness finding stands, on the thread already open (r4011301117) — controllerToken(config.project) at controller-start.ts:333 is the first shape check on `project` and runs after fetchControllerSecret (line 328), while loadControllerStartConfig only requires the key non-empty; so `project: sjawhar/legion` (the daemon's own legion.yaml value, which the daemon loader sanitizes; the form the example's 'same key names as legion.yaml' invites) passes every pre-fetch check, mints and revokes the incumbent controller, then dies with a raw `Error: Invalid Legion project token` that runCli rethrows as a stack trace. Reproduced at head with the test fixture: fetches 1, spawns 0, not a CliError. Threads r4011301104 and r4011301111 (kind overlay operator_token_file; kind walkthrough operator cp) are fixed in bbd36a562b49 and carry my Accepted: replies; r4011301117 carries Still open: with the line, the reproduction, and the fix (validate or daemon-style-sanitize `project` in loadControllerStartConfig before anything else, compute the token before the fetch, regression test asserting fetches is empty). No new thread opened. Rebase audit clean: package.json differs from main only by daemonApiVersion 6 (version 1.36.0 is main's), CHANGELOG only by the contract-6 line, check-dist matches a fresh build on Bun 1.3.14, file set vs main = round 1's 42 + overlays/kind/legion.yaml + deployment-instructions.ts + three .legion handoffs. Every round-1 constraint holds at this head. GitHub note: the replies endpoint wrapped each thread reply in an empty COMMENTED review shell (5204979820, 5204979932, 5204980104 at a0b1dc7c) — no verdict; the round's one review is 5204985576.

threadDispositions.disposition: Accepted: fixed in bbd36a562b49 — kind overlay legion.yaml carries operator_token_file; config.test.ts loads both shipped in-cluster files under --check-config (RED/GREEN verified by the tester and by me).
Accepted: fixed in bbd36a562b49 — the kind shell block copies secrets/operator.env.example beside the providers cp.

Still open: controllerToken(config.project) at controller-start.ts:333 runs after the fetch and is the first shape check on project; `project: sjawhar/legion` mints, revokes the incumbent, then throws a raw Error. Named cases (prompt directory, instructions file) are fixed in fe40d7fa.

keyFindings.description: Line 333 controllerToken(config.project) — the first validation of `project` against /^[a-z0-9]+$/ — runs after fetchControllerSecret (line 328); loadControllerStartConfig (line 123) only requires the key non-empty. `project: sjawhar/legion` (the daemon legion.yaml's value; the daemon loader sanitizes it at config.ts:1186) passes every pre-fetch check, the daemon mints and revokes the running controller's secret and grants, then the command throws a plain Error that runCli rethrows as a stack trace. Fix in loadControllerStartConfig: refuse with a CliError naming key/rule/example, or sanitize exactly as the daemon does; compute the token before the fetch; regression test with fetches === []. Continuation of thread r4011301117, not a new thread.
